caption: The drawing consists of a central scalloped circular shape colored red with a regular pattern of small yellow dots. In the center of this red shape, there is a white area with the word "Mother" written in light red cursive text. Surrounding the central shape, there are four green leaf-like shapes, each decorated with small yellow dots in a regular pattern. These four shapes are symmetrically positioned: one at each diagonal (top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right) around the central red form. All objects are placed within a square inner frame outlined by a thin brown line, with an additional space of plain off-white background surrounding the square on all sides. The full composition is minimal with deliberate positioning and repetition of dot patterns on the colored surfaces.
title: Pieced Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
